title: Swiss Milk Chocolate with Honey & Almond Nougat

details.description: Indulge in a creamy chocolaty ride with Toblerone Milk Bar. Sweet, smooth and lustrous, you get the best milk chocolate in the most fun shape when opting for Toblerone. Prepared and processed from the finest quality milk chocolate, Toblerone is known for its triangular bar shape. You discover the real taste of milk chocolate giving you a sweet sugar rush. It has a wide range of chocolates but Milk Bar is the most basic yet premium and loved by everyone. Great deal if you are a chocolate lover.
details.ingredients: Sugar, Whole Milk Powder, Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Mass, Honey (3%), Milk Fat, Almonds (1.6%), Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin), Egg White, Flavouring (Vanillin), Milk Chocolate (Minimum 28% Cocoa Solids), Milk Solids (Minimum 14%)
details.storageInstructions:
Best for celebrations, gifting options and casual munching. You can use it to make desserts like ice creams, fudge, pudding, cookies, etc. 
It has a shelf life of 457 days.
Storage Instructions: Best to be stored in a cool and refrigerated way.

details.description: Indulge in the classic Swiss taste of Toblerone Crunchy Almonds Chocolate, combining smooth and creamy milk chocolate with crunchy caramelised almonds and a subtle hint of salt. The delicious contrast of creamy, crunchy, sweet and savoury flavours creates a satisfying chocolate experience. With its iconic triangular shape, it is perfect for enjoying as an indulgent snack, sharing with loved ones or taking along while travelling.
details.ingredients:
Sugar, Salted Caramelised Almonds (Almonds (67%), Sugar, Glucose Syrup, Salt, Milk Fat), Whole Milk Powder, Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Mass, Honey (2.5%), Milk Fat, Almonds (1%), Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin), Egg White Powder and Flavouring (Vanillin).
Milk Chocolate Contains: Cocoa Solids 28% Minimum.
Milk Solids: 14% Minimum.
Contains: Egg, Milk, Almonds and Soya.
May Contain: Traces of Other Nuts.
details.storageInstructions: Keep in cool and dry place.

details.description: Indulge in the rich, velvety taste of Toblerone Dark Chocolate, combining smooth dark chocolate with the delicious flavours of honey and crunchy almond nougat. Its distinctive triangular shape and satisfying texture make it an iconic Swiss treat, perfect for enjoying on your own or sharing with friends and family. Whether at home or on the go, Toblerone Dark Chocolate offers a deliciously indulgent chocolate experience.
details.ingredients:
Cocoa Mass, Sugar, Milk Fat, Honey (3%), Almonds (1.6%), Cocoa Butter, Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin) and Egg White.
Plain Chocolate Contains: Cocoa Solids 50% Minimum.
Contains: Milk, Almonds, Soya and Egg.
details.storageInstructions: Keep in a cool and dry place.

details.description: Indulge in the delicious taste of Toblerone Fruit & Nut, made with smooth and creamy Swiss milk chocolate, plump raisins and crunchy almonds. Its iconic triangular shape and delightful combination of soft, chewy fruit and nutty crunch create a satisfying blend of flavours and textures. Perfect for enjoying as an indulgent treat, sharing with loved ones or taking along while travelling.
details.ingredients:
Sugar, Whole Milk Powder, Cocoa Butter, Raisins (12%), Cocoa Mass, Honey (3%), Milk Fat, Almonds (1.6%), Emulsifier (Soy Lecithin), Egg White and Flavouring (Vanillin).
Milk Chocolate Contains: Cocoa Solids 28% Minimum.
Contains: Milk, Tree Nuts (Almonds), Soy and Egg.
details.storageInstructions: Keep in cool and dry place.

details.description: Indulge in the iconic taste of Toblerone White Chocolate, a classic Swiss confection combining smooth and creamy white chocolate with the irresistible flavours of honey and crunchy almond nougat. Its distinctive triangular shape and delicious texture have made it a beloved favourite for generations. Perfect for sharing or enjoying on its own, Toblerone White Chocolate is an indulgent treat to savour at home or while travelling.
details.ingredients:
Sugar, Whole Milk Powder, Cocoa Butter, Honey (3%), Almonds (1.6%), Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin), Egg White and Flavouring (Vanillin).
Contains: Milk, Almonds, Soya and Egg.
details.storageInstructions: Keep in a cool and dry place.

title: Tiny Milk Chocolate with Honey & Almond Nougat

details.description:
Famous Swiss Toblerone chocolate with honey and almond nougat in convenient tiny pieces. This 200g pack has individually wrapped triangular chocolates perfect for sharing. Rich milk chocolate with crunchy almond and honey nougat bits. Premium Swiss quality that's been loved since 1908.
Break off triangular pieces to enjoy. Perfect with coffee, as gifts, or for special occasions. Share with friends and family or save some for later.
details.ingredients:
Sugar, Whole Milk Powder, Cocoa Butter, Cocoa
Mass, Honey (3%), Milk Fat (3%), Almonds (1.6%), Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin (INS
322(I))), Egg White Powder, Flavour (Vanillin). Milk Chocolate Contains Cocoa
Solids 28% And Milk Solids 14%. Food Additives Are Of Plant And Synthetic
Origins.
Allergen Information: Contains Milk, Almonds (Tree Nuts),
Soya, Egg.
details.storageInstructions: Keep in a cool and dry place away from sunlight.

details.description: Toblerone Dark Chocolate Tiny is a classic Toblerone dark chocolate in the distinctive beige packaging is a combination of the finest Swiss dark chocolate with honey and almond nougat. These are the mini version of the traditional dark chocolate. Toblerone milk chocolate is available as a plate, mini, bundle and bar. This iconic triangular chocolate from Switzerland. It is an ideal treat for sharing and snacking while travelling or at home.
details.ingredients: Sugar, Whole Milk Powder, Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Mass, Honey (3%), Milk Fat, Almonds (1.6%), Emulsifier (Soya Lecithin), Egg White, Flavouring (Vaniun), Milk Chocolate (Minimum 28% Cocoa Solids), Milk Solids (Minimum 14%).
details.storageInstructions: Store in a cool, dry and hygienic place to retain freshness.
